bio.text: Mike Fong was elected to the 49th District of the California State Assembly in a special election in February 2022 and chairs the Assembly Higher Education Committee.
Before the Assembly, he served as a Trustee of the Los Angeles Community College District.
Fong graduated from California State University, Northridge with a Master of Public Administration and from UCLA with a B.S. in Psychobiology and a minor in Education.
